outcome: need for surgical/radiological measures including hysterectomy
cohort: All women who delivered at a university hospital between May 2016 and May 2019 and experienced postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) were included.
finding: While there were no significant differences in the overall need for surgical therapy, the chitosan tamponade group showed a significantly lower number of hysterectomies compared to the balloon tamponade group, and its introduction was associated with a 77.8% drop in PPH-related hysterectomies.
